subject.title: fix(ollama): resolve web search secret refs

question: When `models.providers.ollama.apiKey` explicitly contains an unavailable or unsupported SecretRef, should Ollama web search fail before any request even if ambient `OLLAMA_API_KEY` is available?
rationale: This is a deliberate upgrade-sensitive credential-precedence choice: either outcome is technically implementable, but only maintainers can set the permanent user-facing configuration contract.

options.title: Adopt fail-closed precedence
options.body: Treat an explicit configured SecretRef as authoritative and keep this PR's zero-request error behavior when it cannot resolve.

options.title: Retain ambient compatibility fallback
options.body: Allow ambient `OLLAMA_API_KEY` after an unavailable configured SecretRef, accepting the risk that a request uses a credential different from the explicit configuration.

recommendation.title: Adopt fail-closed precedence
recommendation.body: Treat an explicit configured SecretRef as authoritative and keep this PR's zero-request error behavior when it cannot resolve.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR discussion specifically routes the outstanding compatibility choice to this person.
